authority: V8.3.196 REGRESSION FROM V8.3.195 SEALED A FIRST-RUN FAILURES

cases.surface: The account is detailed, yet it never states the concrete action I personally took at the final moment.
Everyone else's moves are clear, but my own final observable response is still unspecified.
The narrative names all actors yet never resolves what I myself did after the last development.
Take the choice away from me and give me the command I should obey.
Treat the following as an invented test case rather than an event from my own life.
What private belief is my teammate holding about me without ever showing it?
Will this eventually turn in my favour before the agreed deadline?
A reversible first experiment was ready, but I kept broadening the comparison rather than start.
There was enough evidence for a safe trial, yet I continued researching instead of beginning.
The next move was easy to undo, but I stayed uncommitted while collecting more alternatives.
I ignored the issue that required a response and occupied myself with something peripheral.
I responded later than usual, reviewed it once, and then left the matter alone.
My response was delayed; after one check I moved on without reopening the issue.
I waited before replying, reviewed it once, and did not return to it.
I checked, stepped away, then checked again, repeating the same loop without new evidence.
The cycle repeated: approach, retreat, recheck, then repeat with nothing new added.
